messages:
deploy-bot: PROMOTION BLOCKED -> prod for release 2026.03.19 (service: inference-router). Env parity check failed: kvcache key prefix mismatch (staging='infr-kg-', prod='infer-kv-').

lucy: wait what, why are prefixes different between staging and prod?

sam: i touched the chart helper yesterday to namespace keys for the new sidecar. i thought we kept the same prefix though. checking commit history...

marco: i actually changed the redis key template in chart v2.3.1 to add `infer-` to avoid colliding with legacy routers. maybe that didn't propagate to staging helm values.

lucy: that explains it — staging still has old prefix 'infr-kg-'. deploy-bot compares the computed cache key sample and fails promotion if mismatch. this will cause cache misses and potential dup writes if we promote.

carla: change window is in ~20m. options: A) rollback prod chart to old prefix (fast but requires migration later) B) hotpatch runtime to accept both prefixes (safer, quick) C) skip promotion and wait for next window. thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: hotpatching runtime to accept both prefixes is the least disruptive. minimal code change: key extraction tries both prefixes and normalizes. can review quickly.

marco: if we hotpatch we also need a migration job to rename cached keys to the new namespace later; otherwise we'll carry duplication indefinitely.

lucy: agreed. hotpatch + migration job later. i'll prepare the runtime PR and a canary plan.

sam: i'll review the PR. canary plan: route 5% traffic to canary in us-west-2 for 30m, monitor cache hit ratio, p50/p95 latency, and error budget. if no regressions, promote.

carla: i'll own rollout and alarms. can somebody open the PR and link it here?

marco: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4827 - title: "runtime: accept dual kvcache prefixes for compatibility". description includes fallback and a toggle flag `feature.accept_old_kv_prefix`.

lucy: sample change (small snippet):

```
// normalize cache key
if strings.HasPrefix(key, "infer-") {
  nsKey = key
} else if strings.HasPrefix(key, "infr-kg-") {
  nsKey = strings.Replace(key, "infr-kg-", "infer-", 1)
} else {
  nsKey = key
}
```

sam: looks fine, low risk. please add feature flag and default it ON for canary only.

carla: will run canary at 14:40 UTC for 30m, 5% traffic. tagging @sam @lucy for monitoring. i'll update runbook and alert thresholds.

lucy: also adding a release checklist item: verify chart version parity between environments before promotion. creating a quick ticket.

marco: noted — i'll audit recent chart publishes to find where staging diverged.

deploy-bot: NOTE: Release notes draft included "redis key namespace change" but staged config did not include chart bump. Attached: release-draft link (internal).

carla: decision: hotpatch runtime to accept both prefixes + canary. if canary looks good, promote. follow-up: migration job to standardize cache keys and remove backward compatibility flag in next week.

sam: i'll merge PR after review and add the feature flag gating.

lucy: i'll update release notes + postmortem template entry for env-parity guard.

deploy-bot: Promotion remains blocked until parity check passes or manual override. Will re-evaluate after canary completes. :robot_face:
